tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, the price card: anything that sits on `bg`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Alternate section bands and table header rows.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Blush highlight: the "two hours back" wedge, callouts, a selected row. `ink` text only.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Navy bands: footer, closing call-to-action band.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-sunken`, `tint`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, help text on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and links on `inverse` (links stay underlined).

tokens.name: on-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `inverse`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brick: the primary button fill. One primary button per view.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button on hover and press.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` and `primary-hover`.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-sunken`. Always underlined.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Inline links on hover.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ember: the rewind arrow and decorative marks only. Never text, never on `bg` as a meaningful mark.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Secondary accent: step numerals, small icons, the "included" checks.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card edges that carry no meaning.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders, secondary button outline: 3:1 on `bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icon, always with a word ("Sent").

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, error border, `[[PROOF NEEDED]]` frames. Always with an icon and a word.

families.serif: "IBM Plex Serif", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif

styles.name: text-display
styles.usage: Page H1, one per page. 36px on phones, 56px on desktop.

styles.name: text-h2
styles.usage: Section headings. 28px on phones, 38px on desktop.
styles.sample: Five things to fix, in order.

styles.name: text-h3
styles.usage: Card and step titles. 21px on phones, 25px on desktop.

styles.name: text-lede
styles.usage: The paragraph under an H1 or H2. Max 2 sentences. 19px on phones, 21px on desktop.
styles.sample: We find where your hours go and give them back.

styles.name: text-body
styles.usage: All running text. Max 68 characters a line. 17px on phones, 18px on desktop.
styles.sample: A 90-minute visit, a written roadmap, and a 30-minute walkthrough.

styles.name: text-strong
styles.usage: Subheads inside cards, table headers, emphasis. 17px on phones, 18px on desktop.

styles.name: text-small
styles.usage: Captions, help text, footer. Never for paragraphs.
styles.sample: Fee credited if you book within 30 days.

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and tags, set in capitals by the component.

styles.name: text-data
styles.usage: Prices, hours, and table figures (tabular numbers).
